name: Artificial Omenpath
description: A temporary doorway made from Kaito's spark, Proft's mind magic, Aminatou's fate magic and a piece of the House, leading from the House to Ravnica.

timeline.summary: Kaito stands before a blue-white door of light, an artificial Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Behind him on the wall was a door formed from blue-white light

timeline.summary: Kaito explains the artificial Omenpath is made of his spark, Proft's mind magic, Aminatou's fate-twisting and a piece of the House.
timeline.quote: My spark, Proft's mind magic, Aminatou's fate-twisting, and a piece of the House that I took with me when I had to planeswalk away.

timeline.summary: Proft closes the door in a spray of moths of light.
timeline.quote: he made a sharp gesture and the door slammed shut, vanishing in a spray of white light shaped like tiny, glittering moths.

pages_say.description: A temporary doorway made from Kaito's spark, Proft's mind magic, Aminatou's fate magic and a piece of the House, leading from the House to Ravnica.
